author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project spill tab, Claire Chicha colors outside the lines with dreamy bedroom pop structures on her full-length debut 'ANGIE.' Live on KEXP, she shares songs off the deluxe record, including a performance of "Suckerrr."
title: spill tab performs "Suckerrr" & more Live on KEXP
